Group rides in Mississippi

15 recurring group rides around Mississippi: 12 road, 5 social. 9 roll on weeknights, 5 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Saturday Core Shop Ride in Tupelo — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Tuesday Night Loop runs 16–25 mph depending on group.
